defmodule InferenceServer.Router do
  use Plug.Router
  import Plug.Conn

  plug :match
  plug :dispatch

  @rate_limit_window 60_000
  @max_requests 100

  post "/api/v1/inference/:model_id" do
    with {:ok, user} <- authenticate(conn),
         {:ok, _} <- check_rate_limit(user.id),
         {:ok, model} <- fetch_model(model_id),
         :ok <- authorize_model_access(user, model) do
      body = read_body_params(conn)
      result = execute_inference(model, body, user)
      send_resp(conn, 200, Jason.encode!(%{result: result}))
    else
      {:error, :unauthorized} -> send_resp(conn, 401, "Unauthorized")
      {:error, :forbidden} -> send_resp(conn, 403, "Forbidden")
      {:error, :rate_limited} -> send_resp(conn, 429, "Rate limited")
      {:error, :not_found} -> send_resp(conn, 404, "Not found")
      {:error, reason} -> send_resp(conn, 500, "Error: #{reason}")
    end
  end

  post "/api/v1/batch_inference" do
    with {:ok, user} <- authenticate(conn),
         {:ok, _} <- check_rate_limit(user.id) do
      body = read_body_params(conn)
      results = process_batch(user, body["requests"])
      send_resp(conn, 200, Jason.encode!(%{results: results}))
    else
      {:error, :unauthorized} -> send_resp(conn, 401, "Unauthorized")
      {:error, :rate_limited} -> send_resp(conn, 429, "Rate limited")
      {:error, reason} -> send_resp(conn, 500, "Error: #{reason}")
    end
  end

  defp process_batch(user, requests) when is_list(requests) do
    requests
    |> Enum.map(fn req -> process_single_request(user, req) end)
    |> collect_with_retry(user)
  end

  defp process_single_request(user, %{"model_id" => model_id} = req) do
    with {:ok, model} <- fetch_model(model_id),
         :ok <- authorize_model_access(user, model) do
      {:ok, model_id, req["input"]}
    else
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, model_id, reason}
    end
  end

  defp collect_with_retry(processed, user) do
    processed
    |> Enum.map(fn
      {:ok, model_id, input} ->
        execute_with_retry(model_id, input, user, 3)
      {:error, model_id, reason} ->
        %{model_id: model_id, error: reason}
    end)
  end

  defp execute_with_retry(model_id, input, user, retries_left) when retries_left > 0 do
    case do_inference(model_id, input, user) do
      {:ok, result} -> %{model_id: model_id, result: result}
      {:error, :timeout} ->
        Process.sleep(exponential_backoff(3 - retries_left))
        execute_with_retry(model_id, input, user, retries_left - 1)
      {:error, :model_busy} ->
        fallback_result = try_fallback_inference(model_id, input, user)
        %{model_id: model_id, result: fallback_result}
      {:error, reason} -> %{model_id: model_id, error: reason}
    end
  end

  defp execute_with_retry(model_id, _input, _user, 0) do
    %{model_id: model_id, error: :max_retries_exceeded}
  end

  defp try_fallback_inference(model_id, input, _user) do
    fallback_model_id = get_fallback_model(model_id)
    case fetch_model(fallback_model_id) do
      {:ok, fallback_model} ->
        InferenceServer.Engine.run(fallback_model, input)
      {:error, _} -> nil
    end
  end

  defp get_fallback_model(model_id) do
    InferenceServer.ModelRegistry.get_fallback(model_id)
  end

  defp do_inference(model_id, input, _user) do
    case fetch_model(model_id) do
      {:ok, model} -> {:ok, InferenceServer.Engine.run(model, input)}
      error -> error
    end
  end

  defp execute_inference(model, body, _user) do
    InferenceServer.Engine.run(model, body["input"])
  end

  defp authenticate(conn) do
    case get_req_header(conn, "authorization") do
      ["Bearer " <> token] -> InferenceServer.Auth.verify_token(token)
      _ -> {:error, :unauthorized}
    end
  end

  defp authorize_model_access(user, model) do
    cond do
      model.visibility == :public -> :ok
      model.owner_id == user.id -> :ok
      user.id in model.shared_with -> :ok
      true -> {:error, :forbidden}
    end
  end

  defp check_rate_limit(user_id) do
    case InferenceServer.RateLimiter.check(user_id, @rate_limit_window, @max_requests) do
      :ok -> {:ok, :within_limit}
      :exceeded -> {:error, :rate_limited}
    end
  end

  defp fetch_model(model_id) do
    case InferenceServer.ModelRegistry.get(model_id) do
      nil -> {:error, :not_found}
      model -> {:ok, model}
    end
  end

  defp read_body_params(conn) do
    {:ok, body, _conn} = Plug.Conn.read_body(conn)
    Jason.decode!(body)
  end

  defp exponential_backoff(attempt) do
    trunc(:math.pow(2, attempt) * 100)
  end
end
